description:
Create one unpaid reservation and binding offer for an explicitly requested new ride. Price-only questions use quote_ride; amendments use prepare_booking_change. Preparation needs no account; private booking access requires separate authorization.

Keep one intent:
- Generate submissionId/resumeToken once and retain the pair with the original ride, contact, locale, offerKey and supplied partner capability.
- A different recipient or language conflicts with the intent; it does not update the offer. Contact identifies a reachable recipient, not a private booking grant.

Complete or recover:
- prepared: open the private checkoutUrl. The customer reviews amount, expiry and full terms, then explicitly confirms and pays there; this call neither charges nor confirms.
- pending/rate_limited: wait retryAfterSeconds, then recover with get_offer_status and the original pair.
- ambiguous/conflict: inspect the original submission; never replace its pair to bypass it.
- available: use returned booking IDs/reference only within the separately authorized booking lifecycle.

get_offer_status reads this submission's subsequent recorded outcome. The resume proof lasts 24 hours from first claimed intake; retries extend neither it nor offer.expiresAt. Keep links and proof private.

contact.description: Customer/booker contact for this explicitly requested offer: email OR E.164 phone is required. Contact does not authorize private booking/history access.

email.description: Reachable customer/booker email, at most 254 characters; required if no phone is supplied.

phone.description: Reachable international E.164 phone, + followed by 7–15 digits, no spaces; required if no email is supplied.

distributionPartnerCapability.description: Optional existing opaque dp_live_ capability issued to an approved distribution partner. Omit for normal customers; do not create or guess one.

firstTouchTrackingToken.description: Optional existing server-issued first-touch UUID token for this tenant and consented attribution. Omit if none; never invent a token or source.

locale.description: Use the customer's requested language for text and booking links: en by default, de for German. Preserve it on retries; pickup times stay in the provider time zone.

offerKey.description: Optional existing published provider/supplier offer key. Selects its configured service location; it is not a customer bookingKey or bookingReference and grants no booking access.

offerRequested.description: Must be true only after the customer explicitly requests an offer; a price question alone is insufficient consent.

resumeToken.description: Caller-generated private 64-character hexadecimal secret for this submission (32 random bytes). Keep its original submissionId pair. The stored resume proof expires 24 hours after first claimed intake; unchanged retries do not renew it. This is separate from offer.expiresAt and is not an account credential.

ride.description: Ride facts with distinct pickup/destination and valid local dates/times. Return requires returnDate/returnTime after pickup; one_way omits both. Hourly requires one_way and hours; transfers omit hours.

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD in the provider timeZone returned by get_service_options; resolve relative dates first.

destination.description: Destination distinct from pickup, with city/municipality or postcode; e.g. München Hauptbahnhof, 80335 München. For hourly service describe the planned route or As directed.

flightNumber.description: Flight number for an airport pickup, such as LH123; omit when not applicable.

hours.description: Booked duration for hourly service; omit for transfers.

luggage.description: Luggage count/type or fit requirements; unusual luggage may require review.

passengers.description: Total people travelling; determines vehicle requirements, not availability or acceptance.

pickup.description: Pickup address or named place with city/municipality or postcode; e.g. Flughafen München (MUC), 85356 München-Flughafen.

returnDate.description: Return pickup date in the same local format as date, in the provider timeZone; provide only for return trips, after the outbound pickup.

returnTime.description: Return pickup time in the same local format as time and the same provider timeZone; provide only for return trips.

serviceType.description: Set hourly for service booked by duration; omit for transfers.

time.description: Local pickup time in 24-hour HH:mm format, in the configured timeZone returned by get_service_options for the same offerKey; not UTC or an offset timestamp.

tripType.description: one_way for a single transfer or hourly service; return for outbound plus a separate later return transfer.

vehiclePreference.description: Volunteered vehicle preference only; no class, price or availability guarantee. Additional requirements may require review.

specialRequests.description: Optional ride requirements, at most 500 characters. Additional stops or unusual requirements may require review; do not include contact details in a quote.

submissionId.description: Caller-generated UUID for one explicitly requested offer intent. Keep the same submissionId/resumeToken and unchanged facts for retries and status; a new explicit intent needs a new pair. This is not a bookingKey.

name: prepare_offer

status.description: Input does not match this operation's contract; correct the facts before retrying.

bookingUrl.description: Published customer booking page for this provider and locale; the URL does not grant private booking access or confirm availability.

status.description: The requested information could not be supplied safely; this is not vehicle-unavailability evidence.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Wait at least this many seconds, then use the same original submissionId/resumeToken pair for status or unchanged retry.

status.description: The original offer-intent execution is still pending; no completed offer result is available.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Wait at least this many seconds before retrying the unchanged submissionId/resumeToken and facts.

status.description: Offer preparation admission was rate-limited; retry only the unchanged explicit offer intent.

conflict means stored intent/offer facts disagree; ambiguous means execution or bound evidence cannot safely be resolved; not_found denies access to the original submission proof. Inspect status rather than blindly creating another offer.

booking.description: Booking state read from the stored reservation; it may lag provider events.

recordedStatus.description: Stored reservation status string. It is not a new provider confirmation.

bookingKey.description: Internal reservation ID for this selected booking. Returned in the available branch of get_offer_status/prepare_offer or an authorized booking read, not in prepared. It grants no access by itself.

bookingReference.description: Stored customer-visible reservation reference, falling back to bookingKey when absent. Customer OAuth accepts it only for its already-selected booking; it is not the supplier offerKey.

customerPortalUrl.description: Private customer-login entry for the original submission proof. This available branch also returns this booking's ID/reference; no history or write authority is granted.

fulfillment.description: Flags derived from stored assignments and status, not live fulfillment confirmation.

chauffeurAssignmentRecorded.description: True when a chauffeur ID is stored on the reservation; it does not confirm dispatch or acceptance.

completionRecorded.description: True only when the stored reservation status is completed; no fresh service-completion check is made.

vehicleAssignmentRecorded.description: True when a vehicle ID is stored on the reservation; it does not confirm availability or execution.

payment.description: Recorded payment state from this booking, without a payment-provider refresh.

recordedStatus.description: Stored reservation payment-status string; no payment or refund is initiated or newly confirmed.

status.description: The selected booking was accessible and its stored fields passed validation; no provider refresh occurred.

bookingUrl.description: Published customer booking page for this provider and locale; the URL does not grant private booking access or confirm availability.

message.description: Customer-language explanation of the required review.

review.description: Structured reason and safe next step for requirements review.

availabilityConfirmed.description: This review result does not confirm availability.

code.description: Reason for further requirements, model, address, service-scope, booking-window or route review; not vehicle-unavailability evidence.

customerContactRequired.description: No customer contact is required for this price/requirements review.

nextAction.description: Review the stated requirements before proceeding; do not infer acceptance or confirmed availability.

status.description: Offer preparation requires review of the ride facts/requirements; availability is not confirmed.
The existing bound offer has expired; this does not extend or describe the separate resume-proof lifetime.

bookingConfirmed.description: Offer preparation does not confirm a booking or charge the customer.

checkoutUrl.description: Private bound offer-review page to review complete terms and explicitly confirm using the existing flow. Treat this offer link as private.

customerPortalUrl.description: Existing private customer-login entry with the original submissionId/resumeToken in its fragment. Keep it private; current session/proof authority is still required.

nextAction.description: Guidance to open checkoutUrl, review the bound terms and explicitly confirm; no confirmation occurred in this call.

offer.description: Existing offer amount, expiry and confirmation/terms requirements.

completeTermsBound.description: Complete service/legal terms were verified as bound to this offer.

currency.description: Currency of the bound offer: EUR.

customerConfirmationRequired.description: The customer must explicitly review and confirm the offer on its page.

expiresAt.description: Stored offer expiry timestamp from offer_expires_at. Separate from the 24-hour submission resume-proof lifetime; re-review an expired or revised offer.

grossTotalCents.description: Bound offer gross total in EUR cents, including applicable tax.

status.description: The existing unpaid draft and its bound offer links are ready for customer review; this branch does not return bookingKey/bookingReference.

termsUrl.description: The same offer page with complete bound service/legal terms.

title: Prepare an unpaid chauffeur offer
